cause: After eight durable-origin retries, Worker Agent returned one physical failure but retained fetch_failures at the terminal value. Because Manager intentionally has no DataID placement state, later B tasks could return to the same permanently poisoned replacement Worker and fail immediately until the 64-attempt infrastructure bound was exhausted.

correction.behavior: The exhausted physical placement still fails once, then the Worker-local object enters a 1.6-second cooldown and resets its bounded retry cycle. Controller replica truth and Scheduler DONE are unchanged.

claim_boundary: r26 is failure diagnosis only and is excluded from performance comparison. TaskVine baseline was correctly not started by the PASS-only supervisor.
